reader.requirement: When REWRITE meets an invalid key condition it is unsuccessful: the file is not updated, the record area keeps its content, and the I-O status shows the cause (21, 22 or 23), with control passing per the INVALID KEY phrase.

edition-consulted.switches: sharing/lock arms of the governed REWRITE (inert with one connector)

reader.edition-search: grep over the REWRITE path (IndexedConnector, FileConnector, FileRegistry, KeyedIoEmitter): the invalid key returns precede IndexedStore.Replace and consult no edition; the record area is never written back by the keyed REWRITE emitter (the released-record store runs only on success).

reader.notes: The connector validates every invalid key condition before IndexedStore.Replace and returns the status; the emitter stores the status and runs the INVALID KEY branch, and does not write to the record area afterwards. Probes cover all three causes, random/dynamic/sequential, REWRITE FROM.
